notes:
July 8th 2026
Version 12.1+ (stable) / 12.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* K-Configurator now speaks your language — the app and the user manual are available in:
  English · Deutsch · Nederlands · Français · Svenska · Italiano · Português · Русский (R)
  It picks up your computer's language on first launch, and you can change it anytime in Preferences. (K,R)
* A brand-new, plain-English K-Configurator user manual — a complete, illustrated guide right from the Help menu, in every supported language, as a web page or a PDF. (R)
* Open a Set file (.FR4 / .FR8) right in the tree view — just like a bank of User Programs — and rename, export, or edit its individual sets in the editor. (R)
* The Live Set Editor — available to beta users only for now — is now feature-complete: read, edit, and write Sets live on your USB-connected accordion, plus Export or Import a single Set (.ST4 / .ST8), with faster, cleaner switching between Set and User Program modes. (R)
* Choose how long tips stay on screen — a new Preferences setting lets you set the pop-up help time in seconds, or keep it up until you move the mouse. (K,R)
* Fixed garbled text that could appear in printed and PDF program and scene lists. (K,R)
* Expansion-pack voices now show the right name — fixed a case where an installed expansion voice could appear as "[Not Installed]". (R)
* A full audit of the Korg scene-file format corrected a couple dozen settings that could display or save incorrectly. (K)
* Fixed treble reed On/Off and Cassotto (register) states that could be lost when saving a program. (R)
* Plus many smaller accuracy and reliability fixes throughout. (K,R)
notes_beta:
July 13th 2026
Version 12.1+ (stable) / 12.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Receive User Programs from your accordion — the reverse of "Send to Accordion." Right-click a User Program or a whole bank in the tree and choose "Receive … from Accordion (Via USB)" to pull it straight off the instrument into your open list, with no USB stick needed. It loads into the file (nothing is saved until you Save, and you can Undo). (R)
* Export the current program or bank to a .UPG / .UPB file right from the Live UPG Editor — the Export options are now always available on the left-hand side. (R)
* Smoother Set / User-Program mode switching in the Live Editor — a "Please wait" message now covers the few seconds it takes to reload (no more blank screen), the mode Switch button stays put instead of jumping, and Set mode now shows the Set's name next to the button, just like User-Program mode. (R)
* The Export (CSV/PDF) button in the tree's Print preview now sits next to Print, so it is no longer cut off on smaller screens. (R)
* Colorblind-friendly "Highlight Differences" — when comparing two backups, the results now use distinct shapes (circle, square, triangle) as well as colors, so matching, renamed, and different items are easy to tell apart at a glance. (K,R)
